Definition: apparently a primary verb; to putrefy, i.e. (figuratively) perish:--be corrupted.
BiblicalUsage: Sepo is rotting, being corrupted, and James turns it on riches: your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that wealth rots where it is hoarded — the moth and the rust are God's auditors.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
